entities.name: Seals
entities.description: Fin-footed, semi-aquatic marine mammals found on Dominaria's shores and in Shadowmoor's rivers.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane whose shores are home to seals and walruses.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The dark half of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, where seals live in rivers.

entities.name: Selkies
entities.description: Creatures associated with seals on Shadowmoor.

relations.note: Seals on Shadowmoor are associated with selkies.
